notes: «عمن صلى مع النبي» is an unnamed transmitter, so the route ends there, without a Companion name.
«وروي عن غير واحد أن النبي ... صلى بإحدى الطائفتين» is a second saying with its own (unnamed) transmission; it is not written as a route and the report needs a ruling.
«قال أبو عيسى» is the compiler's remark and is left out.
